eas.description: Aliyun PAI-EAS OpenAI endpoint. Set EAS_API_* in .env; extra_body may stay here or use EAS_EXTRA_BODY JSON in .env.

bailian.description: Aliyun Bailian Responses API (OpenAI-compatible). Set DASHSCOPE_API_* in .env.

doubao.description: Doubao Realtime Voice API 3.0 (duplex JSON). Set DOUBAO_API_KEY in .env (new console). ASR still uses DOUBAO_APP_ID/ACCESS_KEY or ASR_*.

omni.description: Qwen Omni (/t2sbg-omni) 与 t2sbg (/ws mode=t2s) 共用 Hush 上行降噪；follows vad.provider for local Smart Turn; override with OMNI_VAD=server. TTS lead-in uses debug.t2s_tts_barge_suppress_ms (same as t2sbg). Self-deployed Omni: set self_deployed_ws_url or SELF_OMNI_WS_URL. Hush: weya-ai/hush via libweya_nc (see third_party/hush). smooth_output (Qwen3-Omni-Flash-Realtime only): true=口语化, false=书面化, null=自动; configurable on /t2sbg-omni page.

vad.description: VAD provider: smart_turn_v3 (default), livekit_turn_detector, or duplug. Used by t2sbg and t2sbg-omni. Env: VAD_PROVIDER, SMART_TURN_*, LIVEKIT_TURN_*, VAD_SILENCE_FORCE_SECS.
vad.silence_force_secs_comment: Sustained silence during an active turn before forcing turn end when semantic EOU rejects. 0 = semantic-only.

debug._comment: t2s debug and VAD endpointing tuning (all timings in ms/sec as noted).
debug.t2s_pre_roll_ms_comment: Pre-roll audio kept before first nonidle to avoid clipping initial phonemes.
debug.t2s_speak_grace_ms_comment: After VAD speak, wait this grace window before finalize; canceled if nonidle returns.
debug.t2s_min_speech_ms_comment: Minimum effective speech duration before allowing turn completion.
debug.t2s_min_turn_gap_ms_comment: Minimum interval between two completed turns to prevent rapid re-trigger.
